name: Forward osmosis
applications: hydration bags and niche industrial concentration
principle: Published pilot practice (Modern Water, Oasys): water diffuses across a dense active layer driven by an osmotic draw solution instead of hydraulic pressure, giving low-fouling concentration of difficult feeds; the draw is then regenerated (RO, distillation) releasing clean water; commercial deployment remains niche.

gaps.reason: The IEA guide covers anaerobic digestion but not municipal wastewater process units; no agency TRL exists for most of them. Checked 2026-11-16.

where.hint: IEA ETP Clean Energy Technology Guide (already searched, 634 rows)
Sector regulator or industry body publishing a TRL for this class

gaps.action: Add the TRL only when an agency publishes one for this technology; do not infer it from 'commercial' maturity.

costs.metric: water cost, FO-RO plus AnMBR municipal treatment
costs.basis: Minimum 0.81 EUR/m3 at 50% FO recovery, rising to 1.01 at 80% and 1.27 at 90%; open-loop freshwater comparison 0.80 EUR/m3. Pre-2018 prices as published.

source.note: Vinardell et al., techno-economic analysis of FO-RO combined with AnMBR, read 2026-11-16
